entities.name: Nádia Colhado

entities.summary: Nádia Gomes Colhado is a retired Brazilian professional basketball player. She has competed for the Brazil women's national basketball team at the 2012 and 2016 Summer Olympics, the 2014 FIBA World Championship for Women, and FIBA Americas tournaments.
